ann-sat-1.webp.zh: 从卫星图看，安尼特岛机场（ANN）的跑道嵌在绿色植被与农田之间。
ann-sat-1.webp.en: On the satellite image, the runway at Annette Island Airport (ANN) sits between green vegetation and farmland.

ann-chatgpt-01.webp.zh: 黑白航拍里，机坪与滑行道在杂草间交汇，长条形的机库和几栋矮房沿边排开。
ann-chatgpt-01.webp.en: In this black-and-white aerial, apron and taxiway meet among patchy grass, with a long hangar and a few low buildings along the edge.

ann-chatgpt-02.webp.zh: 机场平面图：两条跑道交叉成X形，标注着07/25与02/20的编号与长度。
ann-chatgpt-02.webp.en: This airport diagram shows two intersecting runways labelled 07/25 and 02/20, with their lengths and field elevation noted.

ann-chatgpt-03.webp.zh: 飞行模拟画面：透过座舱与螺旋桨，前方是雪原中的一条跑道，远处雪山与海面相连。
ann-chatgpt-03.webp.en: A flight-simulator view from the cockpit looks over propeller blades toward a runway in flat snow country, with mountains and sea beyond.

ann-chatgpt-04.webp.zh: 老照片中，铁丝网旁的招牌标明机场服务凯奇坎一带，左侧露出泛美客机的尾翼。
ann-chatgpt-04.webp.en: In an old black-and-white shot, a sign by the chain-link fence says the airport serves Ketchikan and vicinity, a Pan Am tail visible at left.

ann-chatgpt-05.webp.zh: 一张区位示意图：红点标出机场在凯奇坎以南的岛上，图幅还覆盖海达堡与鲁珀特王子港。
ann-chatgpt-05.webp.en: A location map with a plane marker places the airfield on an island south of Ketchikan, the chart also naming Hydaburg and Prince Rupert.
